hourly.summary: Gooners are in that familiar 'dominate but don't score' purgatory after a 30-shot stalemate vs Dortmund — top of the table clash vs City looms large, Soule links persist but Roma's 60m price tag is pure fantasy football, and Gyokeres wearing the #14 in training has the rumor mill spinning faster than a Saka cutback. The 'not finishing top 2 isn't the end of the world' takes are the sound of expectation management kicking in early.

daily.summary: The day began with electric pre-match optimism (8/10) for a marquee Champions League night, fueled by Arsenal's formidable home record and transfer buzz. That energy collapsed into familiar frustration (4/10) after a dominant but wasteful 1-1 draw, with fans decrying a recurring 'Groundhog Day' pattern of slow second-half starts, profligate finishing, and regret over summer transfer inaction — though the healthy league and group standings provide a thin silver lining.

weekly.summary: After riding a wave of euphoric confidence through mid-week — fueled by contract extensions, academy breakthroughs, and table-topping form — Arsenal fan sentiment collapsed dramatically over the weekend. A catastrophic Newcastle draw, Raya's injury scare, and the women's team's managerial crisis triggered a plunge from near-peak optimism (9/10) to structural anxiety (4/10), leaving the fanbase convinced their fragile lead could evaporate at any moment.
